observations: Photo 0 shows a pink plastic case open, revealing a keyboard with 36 keys (12 black, 24 white) inside. The keys have colorful stickers (red, yellow, green, blue, purple, orange) and a white flexible hose attached to the top. The case has a handle and a small window.
Photo 1 shows the closed pink case with 'YAMAHA' embossed on the side. The case appears worn with scuffs and dirt. It is placed on a cluttered surface with boxes and other items.

Photo 2 shows a white plastic case with 'YAMAHA' embossed on the side, placed on top of a keyboard with visible keys. The case has a textured surface and a vertical slot. The keyboard has keys with stickers (red, yellow, green, blue, purple, orange) and a black key cap on the right side.
All photos show a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI AVANT-GARDE MUSIC'.
